clue.text: Captain perhaps losing a pipe and navy trousers

explanation.surface: A ship's captain drops his pipe along with his navy-blue trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Navy' looks like the colour of the trousers but supplies only N.
explanation.definitionFit: Lederhosen are the leather shorts with braces worn in Bavaria and Austria, a kind of trousers.

clue.text: Ex-drinkers accepting sweet soldier's defence

indicators.note: the outer pair takes in the other pieces, as a host accepts guests

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, the fellowship of people who have given up drinking
Polo is a British brand of mint sweet
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: Recovering alcoholics take in a soldier who has a sweet tooth and needs defending.
explanation.walkthrough: POLO is a ring-shaped British mint sweet.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologia is a formal written justification of one's beliefs or conduct, a defence.

clue.text: College zone parking south of river outside of undertakers

P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: only the outer letters of the word undertakers are used, its outside

clue.text: Energetic character and yours truly on stage?

parts.note: a performance given on stage in front of an audience is live

explanation.surface: A lively performer describes himself appearing on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yours truly' is the setter referring to themself, and this puzzle's setter signs as Wire.
explanation.definitionFit: A live wire is an idiom for a lively, energetic and enthusiastic person.

clue.text: Destructive prince blasted over written promises

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece written over another comes above it
the word prince is blown apart and its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A destructive royal goes back on his signed pledges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blasted' looks like an oath at the prince, but it signals the rearrangement; 'over' places that above the promises in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Pernicious means having a harmful, ruinous effect, gradually and subtly destructive.

clue.text: Both uninitiated, Stacy and Bella mounted animal

each of the two names loses its opening letter, its initial

explanation.surface: Two girls, both beginners, climbed on to an animal for a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Both uninitiated' leaves TACY and ELLA; 'mounted' turns TACYELLA upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An alley cat is a stray or street cat, which is an animal.

clue.text: Pleased when surgeon ultimately leaves thyroid?

indicators.note: a letter departs from the organ's word, as the surgeon leaves the theatre

parts.note: the thyroid is an example of a gland

indicators.note: the last letter of surgeon is taken

explanation.surface: Someone asks if the patient is happy once the thyroid surgeon has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: Glad and pleased are synonyms describing happiness about something.

clue.text: Fracturing a hip seems to give you stress

indicators.note: breaking the words a hip seems apart lets their letters be rearranged

explanation.surface: Breaking a hip seems to cause a person a great deal of stress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stress' looks like a noun of worry but is a verb meaning to underline.
explanation.definitionFit: To stress something is to give it emphasis, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Record company name left with guy in Genesis

parts.note: Abel is the son of Adam and Eve killed by Cain in the Book of Genesis

explanation.surface: A record company was named after someone who quit the band Genesis.
explanation.walkthrough: Genesis is also a rock band, so 'left' looks like a member quitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A label is the brand name under which a record company issues its music.

clue.text: Boy cut all gorging, ankles progressively swelling

indicators.note: letters are taken one place further along in each successive word, so the first, then the second, third, fourth and fifth

parts.note: its first letter
its second letter
its third letter
its fourth letter
its fifth letter

explanation.surface: A boy who stuffed himself on everything ended up with swollen ankles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'progressively' is one indicator for five picks: 1st letter of Boy, 2nd of cut, 3rd of all, 4th of gorging, 5th of ankles. The notation cannot hang one indicator on all five picks.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulge is a rounded swelling that sticks out from a surface.

clue.text: Earth footage beginning to explain rare event

parts.note: clips are short pieces of film footage

indicators.note: only the opening letter of explain is used

explanation.surface: Film of the Earth helps explain a rare astronomical happening.
explanation.definitionFit: A solar or lunar eclipse is an uncommon astronomical occurrence.

clue.text: Requirement to return key was irritating

parts.note: a need is a requirement

indicators.note: the keyboard word comes back on itself, read backwards

parts.note: Del is the delete key on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: Having to give a key back annoyed someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Needled means irritated or provoked someone, the past tense of a verb of annoying.

clue.text: Government on Hawaii has evacuated schools

indicators.note: in an across entry, one piece on another follows it

parts.note: HI is the postal abbreviation for Hawaii

indicators.note: the word has is emptied of its middle, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: The Hawaiian government has cleared people out of schools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evacuated' looks like a news report of schools cleared, but it empties 'has' to HS.
explanation.definitionFit: Highs is short for high schools, the secondary schools of the American system.

clue.text: Loud 60s band hoards top-notch moisturiser perhaps

indicators.note: the outer letters store the other piece away inside them

parts.note: F is forte, the musical direction for loud
Cream was a 1960s rock band featuring Eric Clapton
ace means excellent, first-rate

explanation.surface: A noisy sixties group keeps a stash of the best skin product.
explanation.definitionFit: A face cream is a cosmetic preparation such as a moisturiser applied to the skin.

clue.text: Test specialty model Den brought back

parts.note: a field is an area of expertise, a specialty
the Model T was the classic early Ford car, so model gives T

indicators.note: the word for a den is turned around, read backwards

parts.note: a lair is a wild animal's den

explanation.surface: A man named Den tested a speciality model and returned it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Den' looks like a man's name but means an animal's lair.
explanation.definitionFit: A field trial is a test of a product or method carried out in real working conditions.

clue.text: Interfering with tally of awards picked up

indicators.note: heard, as a microphone picks up speech, so the words are judged by their sound

parts.note: a count of medals won is a medal sum

explanation.surface: Someone meddles with the count of prizes collected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' looks like collecting the medals, but signals that MEDAL SUM is spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Meddlesome describes someone given to interfering in other people's affairs.

clue.text: Despise cod art as vulgar — it's often crude

indicators.note: the words despise cod art as are made crude and disordered, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cheap art should be scorned as tasteless, being so often crude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vulgar' seems to describe the art, but signals rearranging DESPISECODARTAS.
explanation.definitionFit: British seaside postcards are famous for bawdy, smutty jokes, so they are often crude.

clue.text: Clint and Emmanuel hiding together

indicators.note: the two names conceal the answer's letters running across them

explanation.surface: Two people, Clint and Emmanuel, are hiding out together.
explanation.definitionFit: In tandem is an idiom meaning working jointly, side by side.

clue.text: Compound of lead cured doctor's inner demon

indicators.note: the word lead is treated and changed in form, as metal or meat is cured, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: Mr Hyde is the evil alter ego of Dr Jekyll in Stevenson's story

explanation.surface: A doctor's lead-based compound treated his evil side.
explanation.definitionFit: An aldehyde is an organic chemical compound containing a CHO group, formaldehyde being one.

clue.text: Mark is amongst sailors retreated for worms

indicators.note: the combined letters go back the way they came, read backwards
one piece sits in the middle of the other, among its letters

parts.note: seamen are sailors
a dot is a small mark

explanation.surface: Mark was with the sailors when they pulled back because of worms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a man but is a DOT; 'retreated' reverses SEDOTAMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Nematodes are roundworms, a phylum of slender unsegmented worms.

clue.text: Mean Grinch regularly spoilt enchantment

indicators.note: every other letter of the two words is ruined and lost, leaving the odd ones

explanation.surface: The mean Grinch ruins the magic of Christmas, as usual.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grinch is Dr Seuss's character who tries to ruin Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Magic is enchantment, the casting of spells or a charming spell-like quality.

clue.text: Coop came good finally with single large clutch?

indicators.note: the final letters of coop, came and good are taken

parts.note: a means one, a single
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A henhouse finally did well with one big clutch of eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutch' with coop suggests eggs, but it is the car pedal; the question mark marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's clutch is operated by a foot lever, one example of a pedal.

clue.text: Draw alien creature with a beak

parts.note: to draw is to pull
ET is the alien from the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: Instructions to sketch a beaked extraterrestrial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like sketching but means pull.
explanation.definitionFit: A pullet is a young hen, which as a bird has a beak.

clue.text: Pioneer in Western, a person without prospects

parts.note: a goner is someone doomed, with no hope left

explanation.surface: A frontier settler in a cowboy film is a doomed character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Western' suggests the film genre but supplies only W.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagoners drove the covered wagons that carried pioneers west, so the word fits a frontier settler.

clue.text: See 4
Population theorist originally had useful stats on cereal

parts.note: malt is germinated cereal grain, usually barley

indicators.note: the original, opening letters of had, useful and stats are taken

explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Malthus was the economist who argued that population outgrows food supply.

clue.text: Pulp tour across frozen country

definitions.meaning: a soft, wet mass of pulped matter
to travel over snow with a dog sled, from the driver's cry to the dogs

explanation.surface: A soft mess made of a trip across an icy land.
explanation.definitionFit: Mush is soft pulpy matter, and as a verb means to travel by dog sled over snow.

clue.text: Preliminarily examine lessons by Catholic church

parts.note: RE is religious education, a school subject
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone checks out religious lessons offered by a Catholic church.

clue.text: 'airy thing maybe hopping about capital

indicators.note: the word for furious is turned about, read backwards

parts.note: hopping, as in hopping mad, means furious

explanation.surface: A furry pet leaps around somewhere in a big city.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in ''airy' marks a dropped H, so the hairy thing becomes 'amster. 'about' reverses MAD to DAM.
